meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 装上后，你给它一个知识库目录，Claude 会先检查它是否符合 Karpathy 模式（有 index.md 和带 [[wikilink]] 的 .md 文件）。符合就解析文章与原始资料，抽取实体、关系和主题，合并成一个知识图谱 JSON，并自动打开仪表盘画面。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析某个知识库目录时触发，可通过参数传入路径；未给路径时使用当前工作目录。

say.text: 分析 /path/to/wiki 目录，生成知识图谱
say.note: Claude 将检测目录格式并启动分析流程。
使用当前目录作为目标 wiki 目录。

say.text: 为这个知识库生成交互式图表并打开仪表盘
say.note: 分析完成后会自动调用 dashboard 展示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude inspects the target directory for a Karpathy-pattern wiki (index.md plus .md files with wikilinks), parses articles and sources, extracts entities, relationships and topics, merges them into a knowledge-graph JSON, then auto-opens the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze a wiki knowledge base directory via the skill's path argument, or falls back to the current working directory.

say_en.text: Analyze /path/to/wiki and build a knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the format and start the pipeline.

say_en.text: Run understand-knowledge on the current directory.
say_en.note: Uses the working directory as the target wiki.

say_en.text: Generate an interactive graph for this knowledge base and open the dashboard.
say_en.note: The dashboard launches automatically after analysis.
